Name: Aasimar
Description: Mortals infused with a spark of the Upper Planes, manifesting divine traits like luminous eyes, glowing halos, or feathery wings.
Character Creation Implications: Grants darkvision, celestial resistance (necrotic/radiant), Healing Hands, and a level 3 transformation (Heavenly Wings, Inner Radiance, or Necrotic Shroud).

Name: Dragonborn
Description: Proud, powerful humanoids descended from dragons, carrying elemental breath weapons and ancestral scale patterns.
Character Creation Implications: Choose a Draconic Ancestry determining breath weapon element and damage resistance. Gain darkvision and draconic flight at level 5.

Name: Dwarf
Description: Stout, subterranean stone-crafters known for unmatched physical endurance, ancestral pride, and deep forge traditions.
Character Creation Implications: Grants darkvision (120 ft), Dwarven Toughness (+1 HP per level), Poison Resistance/Advantage, and Tremorsense via Stonecunning.

Name: Elf
Description: Long-lived children of the Feywild possessing natural grace, keen sensory perception, and innate magical connections.
Character Creation Implications: Choose a Lineage (Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf) granting specific darkvision ranges, movement speeds, and innate spellcasting. Includes Keen Senses and Trance.

Name: Gnome
Description: Small, whimsical, and inquisitive folk with boundless intellectual energy and a natural affinity for magic and invention.
Character Creation Implications: Choose a Lineage (Forest Gnome or Rock Gnome) granting innate illusion/animal speech or tinker utilities. Grants Gnomish Cunning (advantage on INT/WIS/CHA saves).

Name: Goliath
Description: Towering humanoid descendants of giants who thrive in high mountain peaks and value physical achievement.
Character Creation Implications: Choose a Giant Ancestry (Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, or Storm) granting supernatural active abilities. Grants Large Form transformation at level 5 and Powerful Build.

Name: Halfling
Description: Small, cheerful, and extraordinarily lucky folk who value peace, community, hearth, and subtle agility.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Lucky (reroll natural 1s on attacks/checks/saves), Brave (advantage vs frightened), Halfling Nimbleness, and Naturally Stealthy.

Name: Human
Description: Resourceful, adaptable, and ambitious mortals who build expansive cultures and master diverse skills across every corner of the realm.
Character Creation Implications: Grants a bonus Origin Feat at level 1, Skill Versatility (extra skill proficiency), and Heroic Inspiration after every long rest.

Name: Orc
Description: Resilient, action-oriented warriors blessed with physical endurance and relentless vitality.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Adrenaline Rush (Dash as bonus action gaining temporary HP), Relentless Endurance (drop to 1 HP instead of 0 once/long rest), and 120 ft Darkvision.

Name: Tiefling
Description: Mortals bearing fiendish heritage from the Lower Planes, marked by horns, tails, sharp teeth, and unnatural skin tones.
Character Creation Implications: Choose a Fiendish Legacy (Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal) defining innate spell progression and damage resistance (Poison, Necrotic, or Fire). Grants Thaumaturgy and Darkvision.

Name: Aarakocra
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Avian humanoids hailing from the Elemental Plane of Air, resembling eagles and parrots.
Character Creation Implications: Grants natural flight speed equal to walking speed (cannot wear medium/heavy armor), Wind Caller spellcasting (Gust of Wind), and Talon natural weapons.

Name: Astral Elf
Description: Elves who migrated to the Astral Plane eons ago, gaining cosmic longevity and starlight magic.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Astral Step (bonus action teleportation), Starlight Step/Radiant Soul abilities, Keen Senses, Trance, and choice of cantrip.

Name: Autognome
Description: Mechanical gnomish constructs built for exploration, survival, and specialized labor.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Construct. Grants Built for Success (add d4 to rolls), Armored Casing (base AC 13 + Dex), Healing Machine (beneficial healing spell rules), and poison immunity.

Name: Bugbear
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Hairy, long-limbed goblinoids known for stealthy ambush tactics and deceptive strength.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Long-Limbed (+5 ft melee reach), Surprise Attack (+2d6 damage vs targets that haven't acted), Powerful Build, Sneaky proficiency, and Fey Ancestry.

Name: Centaur
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Upper body of a humanoid and lower body of a horse, embodying wild nature and swift overland travel.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Fey. Speed 40 ft. Grants Charge (bonus action Hooves attack after moving 20 ft), Hooves natural weapons, Equine Build (climbing penalties), and Survival skills.

Name: Changeling
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Shapechangers capable of altering their physical appearance to match any humanoid face.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Fey. Grants Shapechanger trait (alter appearance/voice at will as an action) and Instincts (choice of 2 face-of-the-party skill proficiencies).

Name: Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Subterranean gnomes who guard secret caverns using innate stealth and stone magic.
Character Creation Implications: Grants 120 ft Darkvision, Svirfneblin Camouflage (advantage on Stealth in rocky terrain), Gnomish Cunning, and Gift of the Svirfneblin innate spells.

Name: Dhampir
Description: Lineage tied to vampires, living between life and undeath with an insatiable hunger.
Character Creation Implications: Gains Vampiric Bite (empowers checks or heals), Spider Climb (walk on walls/ceilings equal to walking speed), 60 ft Darkvision, and ancestral skill retention.

Name: Duergar
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Underdark dwarven kin shaped by Psionic energy and generations in deep subterranean realms.
Character Creation Implications: Grants 120 ft Darkvision, Duergar Magic (Enlarge/Reduce and Invisibility), Psionic Fortitude (advantage vs illusion/charm/paralysis), and Poison Resistance.

Name: Eladrin
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Feywild elves attuned to the four seasons, whose emotional states mirror seasonal energies.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Fey Step (bonus action teleportation with seasonal rider effects: Autumn charm, Winter fear, Spring ally teleport, Summer fire damage), Trance, and Keen Senses.

Name: Fairy
Description: Tiny or small winged folk infused with the untamed illusion and enchantment of the Feywild.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Fey. Grants Flight (equal to walking speed in light armor) and Fey Magic (Druidcraft, Faerie Fire, Enlarge/Reduce).

Name: Firbolg
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Gentle forest giants who protect woodland habitats with nature magic and subtle camouflage.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Firbolg Magic (Detect Magic, Disguise Self), Hidden Step (bonus action invisibility), Speech of Beast and Leaf, and Powerful Build.

Name: Genasi (Air)
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Mortals touched by elemental air, carrying breezy hair, blue skin, or vortex breath.
Character Creation Implications: Speed 35 ft. Grants Unending Breath (hold breath indefinitely), Lightning Resistance, and Air Genasi Magic (Shocking Grasp, Feather Fall, Levitate).

Name: Genasi (Earth)
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Mortals tied to elemental earth, featuring stone-like skin, crystalline eyes, or dust trails.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Earth Walk (ignore difficult terrain on stone/earth) and Earth Genasi Magic (Blade Ward as bonus action, Pass Without Trace).

Name: Genasi (Fire)
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Mortals infused with elemental fire, boasting ember hair, warm touch, and fiery tempers.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Darkvision (flame-tinged), Fire Resistance, and Fire Genasi Magic (Produce Flame, Burning Hands, Flame Blade).

Name: Genasi (Water)
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Mortals connected to elemental water, bearing moisture-kissed skin, hair like waves, or fluid movements.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Swim Speed equal to walking speed, Amphibious breathing, Acid Resistance, and Water Genasi Magic (Acid Splash, Create/Destroy Water, Water Walk).

Name: Githyanki
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Astral warriors who escaped mind flayer bondage, mastering psionic swordplay and planar dragon riding.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Astral Knowledge (gain proficiency in one skill and tool per long rest), Psychic Resistance, and Githyanki Psionics (Mage Hand, Jump, Misty Step).

Name: Githzerai
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Ascetic monks dwelling in Limbo who train their minds to master order amid chaotic planar storms.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Mental Discipline (advantage vs charmed/frightened), Psychic Resistance, and Githzerai Psionics (Mage Hand, Shield, Detect Thoughts).

Name: Goblin
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Small, quick fey-descended scavengers known for guerrilla survival tactics and sneaky reflexes.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Nimble Escape (Disengage or Hide as a bonus action), Fury of the Small (bonus damage equal to proficiency bonus), Darkvision, and Fey Ancestry.

Name: Grung
Description: Small, aggressive amphibious frog-folk from tropical rainforests with poisonous skin.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Poisonous Skin (contact damage/condition), Poison Immunity, Standing Leap, Amphibious, and Water Dependency (must immerse in water daily).

Name: Hadozee
Description: Simian arboreal travelers with winglike membranes used for gliding across Wildspace vessels.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Glide (glide horizontally without falling damage), Dexterous Feet (bonus action object interaction), and Hadozee Resilience (reduce damage taken).

Name: Half-Elf (Legacy 2014)
Description: Mortals combining human adaptability with elven elegance, often navigating between two worlds.
Character Creation Implications: Grants +2 CHA and +1 to two other scores, Fey Ancestry, Darkvision, and Skill Versatility (2 free skill proficiencies).

Name: Half-Orc (Legacy 2014)
Description: Powerful, resilient humanoids inheriting the tenacity of humans and ferocity of orcs.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Relentless Endurance (survive 0 HP once/long rest), Savage Attacks (extra critical hit weapon die), Menacing (Intimidation proficiency), and Darkvision.

Name: Harengon
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Bipedal rabbit-folk from the Feywild possessing keen reflexes, perception, and explosive leaps.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Hare-Trigger (add proficiency bonus to initiative), Rabbit Hop (bonus action jump without triggering opportunity attacks), Lucky Footwork, and Perception skills.

Name: Hexblood
Description: Individuals infused with hag magic through bargains, rituals, or lineage transition.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Fey. Grants Eerie Token (detach tooth/hair for remote viewing/telepathy), Hex Magic (Disguise Self, Hex), and 60 ft Darkvision.

Name: Hobgoblin
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Disciplined goblinoids who value social hierarchy, group coordination, and martial solidarity.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Fey Gift (Help action as bonus action with temp HP/speed riders), Fortune from the Many (bonus to failed rolls based on nearby allies), and Darkvision.

Name: Kalashtar
Source: Eberron: Rising from the Last War
Description: Compound beings formed by the union of human bloodlines and celestial dream-spirits (Quori).
Character Creation Implications: Grants Dual Mind (advantage on WIS saves), Mental Discipline (psychic resistance), Mind Link (telepathy), and Severed from Dreams (immunity to dream-based spells).

Name: Kenku
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Flightless avian folk cursed without natural voices, using flawless mimicry to communicate.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Expert Duplicate (advantage on copying handwriting/crafts), Mimicry (reproduce any heard sounds/voices), and Kenku Recall (gain skill proficiencies and advantage).

Name: Kobold
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Small reptilian humanoids claiming draconic lineage, utilizing clever traps and pack tactics.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Draconic Cry (grant allies advantage on attacks), Kobold Legacy (choice of cantrip, skill, or tail attack), and 60 ft Darkvision.

Name: Leonin
Description: Proud, lion-like feline humanoids native to grassy plains who guard their prides fierce independence.
Character Creation Implications: Speed 35 ft. Grants Daunting Roar (bonus action roar causing fear), Claws natural weapons, Darkvision, and Hunter's Instincts.

Name: Lizardfolk
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Coldly practical reptilian humanoids who view the world through pure survival and resourcefulness.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Natural Armor (13 + Dex), Bite natural weapon, Hungry Jaws (bonus action bite granting temp HP), Hold Breath (15 min), and Nature skills.

Name: Locathah
Description: Resilient piscene (fish-folk) ocean dwellers who defend coastal underwater territories.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Natural Armor (12 + Dex), Leviathan Will (advantage on saves vs charm/fear/paralysis/poison), Swim speed, and Limited Amphibiousness (requires water every 4 hours).

Name: Loxodon
Description: Elephantine humanoids famed for wisdom, calm demeanor, stonework, and immense strength.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Natural Armor (12 + Con), Trunk (prehensile manipulation/grapple), Loxodon Serenity (advantage vs charmed/frightened), and Keen Smell.

Name: Minotaur
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Bovine humanoids possessing formidable horns, labyrinthine navigational sense, and martial zeal.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Horns natural weapons, Goring Rush (Dash then attack with horns as bonus action), Hammering Horns (shove as bonus action after attack), and Labyrinthine Recall.

Name: Owlin
Description: Owl-like humanoids connected to the Feywild, silent flyers with nocturnal vision.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Flight speed equal to walking speed (in light armor), 120 ft Darkvision, and Stealth proficiency (silent feathers).

Name: Plasmoid
Description: Amorphous sentient slimes that can mold their bodies into pseudopods or humanoid forms.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Ooze. Grants Amorphous (squeeze through 1-inch spaces), Shape Self (extend pseudopods), Hold Breath (1 hr), Acid/Poison resistance, and Darkvision.

Name: Reborn
Description: Individuals reanimated through magic, science, or unfinished business, clinging to fractured memories.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Deathless Nature (no sleep/food/breath required, advantage vs poison/disease, advantage on death saves) and Knowledge from a Past Life (d6 to checks).

Name: Satyr
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Caprine fey folk who embody freedom, music, celebration, and hedonistic merriment.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Fey. Speed 35 ft. Grants Magic Resistance (advantage on saves vs all spells), Mirthful Leap, Ram natural weapon, and Performance/Persuasion skills.

Name: Shadar-kai
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Elves bound to the Raven Queen in the Shadowfell, gray-skinned and attuned to gloom and decay.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Blessing of the Raven Queen (bonus action teleportation with resist-all damage resistance rider), Necrotic Resistance, Trance, and Darkvision.

Name: Shifter
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Humanoids with distant lycanthropic ancestry, capable of briefly tapping into feral traits.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Shifting (bonus action transformation gaining temp HP and subclass feature: Beastehide, Longtooth, Swiftstride, or Wildhunt) and Darkvision.

Name: Simic Hybrid
Description: Humanoids bio-magically merged with animal traits by the Simic Combine.
Character Creation Implications: Choose Animal Enhancements at Level 1 (Manta Glide, Nimble Climber, Underwater Adaptation) and Level 5 (Grappling Appendages, Carapace, Acid Spit).

Name: Tabaxi
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Feline humanoids driven by wanderlust, curiosity, and explosive bursts of agility.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Feline Agility (double speed for a turn), Cat's Claws (climbing speed and unarmed strikes), Darkvision, and Perception/Stealth proficiencies.

Name: Thri-kreen
Description: Insectoid humanoids with carapace armor, four arms, and psionic telepathy.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Monstrosity. Grants Secondary Arms (manipulate light items/weapons), Chameleon Carapace (AC 13 + Dex and camouflage), Thri-kreen Telepathy, and Sleepless rest.

Name: Tortle
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Reptilian turtle-folk carrying their houses on their backs, simple wanderers and natural survivalists.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Natural Armor (fixed AC 17, cannot wear armor), Shell Defense (withdraw into shell for +4 AC), Claws, Hold Breath (1 hr), and Survival skills.

Name: Triton
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Aquatic guardians from the Elemental Plane of Water who protect ocean depths from dark horrors.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Amphibious, Swim speed equal to walking speed, Cold Resistance, Fog/Water innate spellcasting, Emissary of the Sea, and Darkvision.

Name: Vedalken
Description: Tall, blue-skinned humanoids who pursue perfection and cold logical mastery above all else.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Vedalken Dispassion (advantage on INT, WIS, CHA saves), Tireless Precision (bonus d4 to choice of skill/tool), and Partially Amphibious.

Name: Verdan
Description: Mutated goblinoids transformed by chaos magic, physically expanding as they mature.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Black Blood Healing (reroll 1s/2s on Hit Dice), Telepathic Hub, Persuasive, and Growth Spurt (size changes from Small to Medium at level 5).

Name: Yuan-ti
Source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
Description: Serpentine humanoids blessed with serpent characteristics and innate psionic magic.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Magic Resistance (advantage on saves vs spells), Poison Resilience (resistance and save advantage), Serpentine Spellcasting (Poison Spray, Animal Friendship), and Darkvision.

Name: Awakened Animal
Description: Former wild beasts granted sentient humanoid intelligence through Druidic Awaken rituals.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Beast. Retains animal physical form, natural weapons, and beast senses while gaining humanoid language, intellect, and class abilities.

Name: Bearfolk
Description: Massive Ursine humanoids from northern wilderness lands known for shamanic strength and warrior honor.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Thick Hide (Natural Armor), Bite/Claw attack actions, Powerful Build, and Ursine Ferocity.

Name: Disembodied
Description: People caught in planar magical accidents whose physical forms drift partially into the Ethereal Plane.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Fade Away (brief ethereal phase to bypass obstacles or reduce damage) and Planar Dislocation features.

Name: Downcast
Description: Fallen angelic beings stripped of divine grace who now wander mortal lands in mortal flesh.
Character Creation Implications: Choose an Archseraph heritage determining divine spells and lingering celestial traits despite lost divinity.

Name: Gearforged
Description: Mortals whose consciousness and soul have been transferred into elaborate brass, steel, and clockwork bodies.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Construct. Does not sleep/eat/breathe; requires daily gear-winding maintenance and specialized repair kits.

Name: Hollow One
Source: Explorer's Guide to Wildemount (Darrington Press / WotC)
Description: Supernatural lineage for creatures who died but whose bodies revived without a soul, preserved by tragic fate.
Character Creation Implications: Retains base species stats while adding Ageless, Clinging to Life (d20 turn undead/death save advantage), Unsettling Presence, and Undead Revenant nature.

Name: Laneshi
Description: Pale, amphibious aquatic humanoids from deep trenches who revere ancestral necromancy.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Swim speed, Amphibious, Resistance to Cold/Necrotic, and innate dark underwater magic.

Name: Ratatosk
Description: Small, mischievous squirrel-folk messenger celestials who travel up and down the cosmic World Tree.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Climbing speed, Sharp Teeth natural weapon, Skittering agility, and Gossip/Messenger Planar magic.

Name: Ravenfolk (Huginn)
Description: Wingless raven-like tricksters and scholars who revere fate, secrets, and clever trickery.
Character Creation Implications: Grants Feat of Memory, Mimicry, Beak strike, and natural deception skill proficiencies.

Name: Wechselkind
Description: Small artificial porcelain or wooden changeling dolls animated by fey magic, left behind when human children are stolen.
Character Creation Implications: Creature Type is Construct. Grants Artificial Form (no food/sleep), Childlike Glamour (magical disguise as a human child), and Fey Resilience.
